name: Draft my project’s devblog
description: Use when a site owner wants a weekly devblog from merged changes, with evidence, screenshots and human publication review.
instructions: Ask for the site service id and its configured blog handle. Use POST https://openvibe.blog/api/v1/blogs/{handle}/posts/devblog with {service}. The authenticated owner is the actor; never impersonate another person. Blog gathers changelog stories and stored screenshots, then runs the content.devblog workflow using the blog.devblog.write AI choices task. It returns a draft post. Show the owner its editor URL /write/posts/{id} and the run provenance. Never publish, approve, schedule, buy artwork, or change a saved model choice. A 409 means a weekly reservation, cadence limit or pending attempt; show that result rather than circumventing it. A failed run is not a draft. The same action serves every configured site, including the network’s own sites.
